lines: Without a licence a package may not be distributed at all; ask its maintainers for one, or replace it.
The 339 shipped packages by licence: MIT 282, GPL-3.0-or-later 12, ISC 11, BSD-3-Clause 10, BSD-2-Clause 8, none 3, AGPL-3.0 2, Apache-2.0 2, and 9 licences more.
The app is under AGPL-3.0-or-later, as appinfo/info.xml declares; licences.json held each licence against it.
The advisories were not checked (NO_ADVISORIES=1 or --no-advisories): this report says nothing about vulnerable packages.
